newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Nov 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Nov 11.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
Qiao Shi, chairman of the National People's Congress, says on a trip to Jordan that a visit by King Hussein to China will aid the Middle East peace process.

Zhang Wannian, vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission, inspects army units in the northern province of Shanxi and in the northern Inner Mongolia region, and urges that priority be given to ideologicial and political work.
Premier Li Peng says on a visit to Brazil that history will prove that China is correct to follow a path of building socialism with Chinese characteristics.
The People's Bank of China, the central bank, says the current interest rate level is suitable.
The value of China's tertiary industries will account for 35 percent of the gross domestic product in the year 2000. Priority will be given to developing housing, tourism and communication.
